key_impacts: Flooding exceeded New York City’s 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Hess Port Reading and Bayway (Phillips 66) refineries in New Jersey were shut down, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 bpd capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outage.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate because of the outage.
evidence_snippets: Its arrival on the evening of October 29 coincided almost exactly with high tide and generated a massive surge in New York Harbor.
As of November 6 2012, Hess Port Reading Refinery... and Bayway Refinery Phillips 66 in Linden, New Jersey, were shut down.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn had to emergently evacuate all patients due to the outage.
missing_information: Specific hospital names and exact evacuation dates not provided.
Outage figures and fatalities are regional; NYC-specific counts not given.
